title: Reading Drill — The Edge of a Pond
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: The Edge of a Pond
passages.body:
**A** Volunteers counted young frogs around a pond to see whether a newly planted bank provided shelter. Their records distinguished frogs on the bank from animals among the floating leaves.

**B** On dry mornings the planted bank had few frogs, despite looking like good habitat. Counts rose after rain, so observers added a column to their sheet for recent rainfall.

**C** Rather than concluding that the bank was unsuccessful, the group waited for another season. It planned to compare the same dates with a nearby unplanted pond whose shore had not been altered.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Their records distinguished frogs on the bank from animals among the floating leaves.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: It planned to compare the same dates with a nearby unplanted pond whose shore had not been altered.

questions.prompt: A second pond was used for comparison in the first season.
questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
